run_tool_bench_llama_server: run tool call benchmarks on llama-server with a HuggingFace GGUF model at multiple temperatures
run_tool_bench_ollama: run tool call benchmarks on ollama with a specified model tag at multiple temperatures
run_tool_bench_compare: run tool call benchmarks comparing current llama-server against a baseline binary
plot_benchmark_heatmap: plot benchmark results from JSONL files as a success rate heatmap
plot_benchmark_filtered: plot benchmark results from JSONL files filtered by test regex and server regex
